keep.text: India mein har chautha se paanchva aadmi sharaab pee raha hai, khoob
bhar-bhar ke.
Raat ko neend nahi aati hai toh ek drink le lete hain,
so jaayenge easily, neend aa jaayegi easily. 8 ghante soye, subah uthe
aur phir bhi thake hue,
jaise soye hi nahi hain.
Kyunki aap log sach mein nahi soye hote ho, ye fake sleep hoti hai.
Samjho neend koi ek aisi cheez nahi hai jo aap logon ko nashe se aa rahi hai.
Neend ke 4 stages hote hain, ye achhe tareeke se sun lijiye.
Chaaron stages mein aap logon ko define kar deta hoon.

Stage 1 se 2, light sleep hoti hai, body ismein relax rehti hai, but aap sahi tareeke se soye nahi hote, light sleep ki baat kar raha hoon. Stage 3 mein aap deep sleep mein pahunchte ho, body yahan par aapki repair hoti hai, aur generally jab 8 ghante aap sote ho na toh 2.5 ghante se zyada deep sleep mein body nahi jaa paati hai.
Aur deep sleep mein muscles, bone, immune system ye sab ke sab fix ho rahe hote hain.
Aur stage 4, yahan par REM sleep hoti hai.
Brain organize ho raha hota hai,
aapki jo memory hai na wo consolidate hoti hai, aur
emotions process hote rehte hain.
Tab jaa karke aap logon ki poori ki poori neend complete hoti hai.
Ab alcohol kya karta hai? Stage 1 se stage 2
fast kara deta hai, samajh rahe ho aap?
Toh aap logon ko light sleep aa jaati hai,
aap log jaldi se so jaate ho.
Par stage 3 aur REM sleep ko ekdam destroy kar deta hai.
Matlab body repairing nahi karti hai, brain organizing nahi ho paata hai, aur subah ekdam thake thake se aap log uthte ho.
Aur yahi thakaan aap logon ko lagta hai ki
hangover, aur ye saari cheezein aap logon ko dikhaati hai.
Jab aap lambe time tak soge nahi,
toh hangover waali position waise bhi aa jaayegi.
Studies mein dekha gaya hai ki same breakfast khaaya,
6 ghante soya bhi,
but zyada glucose spike ho gayi.
7 ghante, medium medium.
8 ghante ki neend bhi li, quality sleep li,
aur ismein sabse kam insulin spike hui.
Matlab aap din bhar kuch bhi karo
aur neend sahi nahi hai,
toh glucose management poora ka poora fail ho jaayega.
Diet fail ho jaayegi, exercise fail ho jaayegi, sab ka sab fail ho jaayega.
6 ghante sone waale log, 40% se zyada
fracture ho jaata hai
aur osteoporosis ho jaata hai.
Sleep mere health
protocol ka sabse chhupa hua pillar hai.
Aur log sochte hain ki protocol ka matlab sirf diet, exercise, meditation aur ye saari cheezein hogi, but sleep is the most important thing.
Agar aap sahi tareeke se soge nahi,
toh aapki body repair hogi nahi,
aur jab repair nahi hogi,
toh body toot-ti chali jaayegi, toot-ti chali jaayegi, daily daily thake rahoge, aur kabhi bhi aap log patle nahi ho paoge, workout karne ke baad bhi aur achhi diet khaane ke baad.
Aur ye mere saath ho chuka hai,
isliye main aap logon ko bata raha hoon.
Agar aap logon ko bhi mera poora ka poora system chahiye,
toh comment box mein likho SYSTEM,
aur
mera system le karke jaaiye.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai.
